designs.label: Cloud baffle
designs.prompt: Project-authored suspended cloud acoustic baffle. Use one closed .06m-thick horizontal panel, four ceiling pads and four positive-thickness rods.

designs.label: Linear baffles
designs.prompt: Project-authored suspended linear acoustic baffle. Use two independent horizontal bars with a visible gap, each connected to the four ceiling pads through rods.

designs.label: Felt fins
designs.prompt: Project-authored suspended felt acoustic baffle. Use multiple parallel vertical fins joined by one closed top rail, four ceiling pads and rods.

designs.label: Timber grid
designs.prompt: Project-authored suspended timber grid acoustic baffle. Use a closed rear backing, crossing timber slats and a top rail that receives all four rods.

promptStandard: Purpose: authored static ceiling acoustic decor with four real top pads, positive-thickness rods and four distinct baffle structures. Units are metres, +Y is up, +Z is forward, and the origin is the ceiling mounting plane centre. Keep every component a closed axis-aligned box solid, use opaque untextured MeshStandardMaterial, binary GLB, no textures, lights or animation, and no external art assets. The game envelope is x [-.6,.6], y [-.3,0], z [-.2,.2].
